confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant, café, and drink anchors are medium confidence. Accommodation anchors are lower confidence and assume a July (NZ winter, low-to-shoulder season) booking window, with taxes included. Cocktail and wine anchors are cross-checked against the beer anchor based on the usual local price relationship. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange rates table, not from a direct page read; the summaries agree on 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 and 0.6955 for 2026-10-15, so verify against the RBA page before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No search was used for city prices. Estimates are based on general knowledge of Wellington central-city pricing, converted from NZD at an assumed rate of roughly 0.58 USD per NZD. Positioned close to Auckland and other New Zealand city-centre pricing, with Wellington's café culture informing the coffee and mid-range restaurant anchors.
